#Third hit cannot be executed without a successful second hit
#The first hit can be blocked, and the second unblockable hit can be avoided by sidestepping or backdashing
#Without a clean hit, there is no Crumple Fall property and the move does 25 damage
# Pressing u or d will cause True Ogre to "sidestep" in the corresponding direction during the move
